pcs.pc_description: check safety norms of the defined area and inform the safety in charge if not suitable
interpret the process flow chart/formulation chart for products to be produced

inspect the quantity and quality of the received raw material against specification to ensure it meets the quality standards. Raw material: Sugar cane etc. Quality standards: Purity and cleanliness, Chemical Composition, Pesticide and chemical residue levels, etc.
maintain inventory while effectively storing raw material in designated areas
prepare and set up the machines for sugar processing. Machines: Extraction machinery, Cane preparatory devices,Mills, etc.
conduct equipment inspection and maintenance to ensure good operator order
• prepare quality control tools and devices for monitoring essential factors. • Factors: Humidity,temperature, pressure, pH, etc.
calibrate and validate the quality control equipment for accurate test results
• ensure there are ample supplies of packaging materials for packing the finished sugar product. • Packaging materials: cartons, Sugar bags,containers, etc.

• perform safety inspections and ensure that all safety equipment is accessible and in good working order. • Equipment: personal equipment, emergency response equipment, etc.

modules.module_title: Processing of Sugar

pcs.pc_description: manage sugar extraction equipment, such as cane preparatory devices,mills, etc. to extract the in to juice from sugarcane

• oversee and update the extraction parameters to maximize juice extraction and sugar yield • Parameters: crushing or milling speed, Pressure, Feed rate, cutting size, extraction time, temperature, moisture content, sucrose content, etc.
clean sugarcane juice from contaminants and solids by following the clarification process
remove suspended particles by using filtering machinery to ensure juice clarity
control the evaporation process to lower the water content and raise sugar concentration
• monitor and adjust parameters of the evaporation equipment. • Parameters: temperature, pressure, flow rates, etc.
manage crystallization process for creating sugar crystals
• alter variables to get desired size and quality of crystals. • Variables: seeding, temperatures, etc.
separate sugar crystals from molasses- containing liquid through centrifuges
administer drying process to completely dry sugar crystals
sustain ideal conditions and temperatures to ensure product quality

modules.module_title: Conduct quality tests and inspections

pcs.pc_description: • monitor the efficiency of crushers or mills by observing essential factors while extracting sugar cane juice. • Factors: juice flow rates, pulp discharge, etc.
• examine extracted juice to assess its initial parameters. • Parameters: sugar concentration, colour, clarity, etc.
administer the clarifying and filtering operations to confirm the removal of contaminants and suspended particles
conduct routine turbidity and suspended solids testing to evaluate the working of filtration and clarifying process
oversee the evaporation and concentration processes to decrease water content and raise sugar concentration
regulate brix (sugar concentration) testing to ensure it complies with specified requirements
analyze the crystal samples periodically to verify that size and purity are within standards
analyze sugar recovery rate and separation efficiency
check product’s temperature and moisture content on a regular basis
oversee extensive quality checks on purity, color, sucrose content and particle size

modules.module_title: Carry out preventive planned maintenance

pcs.pc_description: • check for wear, damage, or malfunction on a regular basis on all processing machinery. • Machinery: mills, juice heaters,clarifier, evaporators,pans, crystallisers, centrifuge, , drying units, etc.
perform operational and visual inspections to identify any anomalies or possible problems
lubricate appropriately moving components to decrease friction and prevent wear
• prevent performance issues by keeping equipment away from contaminants. • Contaminants: debris, sugar residue, acids, other impurities, etc.
• maintain alignment and ensure proper assembly of parts. • Parts: loose bolts, nuts, fasteners, etc.
replace filters and screens per maintenance plan recommendations in order to avoid clogging
examine or replace drive systems, chains, and conveyor belts to avoid belt or chain failures
• inspect appropriate parts for loose connections or corrosion. • Parts: wiring, control panels, electrical connections, etc.
verify sensors, switches and control systems are operating properly
• monitor cooling and heating systems for technical issues • Cooling and Heating system: heat exchangers, condensers, etc. • Technical issues: leaks, obstructions, temperature changes, etc.
examine or replace damaged seals, gaskets and lubricate pumps if required
• make sure safety precautions are working as intended • Safety precautions: emergency stops, safety guards, etc.
adhere to preventive maintenance schedule created by maintenance department

modules.module_title: Perform troubleshooting of equipment issues

pcs.pc_description: safely shutdown or isolate damaged equipment to avoid further harm
• identify equipment problems that can assist in comprehending source of issue • Problem identification: through strange sensations, noises, visual indications, etc.
conduct methodical testing and isolation of components or subsystems to identify precise location and cause of problem
check wiring, connections and device parts for signs of wear, damage and loose connections
• inquire about equipment operating circumstances • Circumstances: current maintenance history, operating parameters, modifications to process conditions, etc.
• evaluate performance of equipment and collect information by using diagnostic tools and equipment • Tools and equipment: meters, gauges, sensors, etc.
• interpret instrument readings and use it for troubleshooting along with coworkers • Coworkers: managers, engineers, maintenance staff, etc.
categorize any possible contributing elements or circumstances that may result in recurrent issues and suggest preventive steps to avert such issues

modules.module_title: Carry out documentation to ensure compliance

pcs.pc_description: • gather information and keep records of each manufacturing batch’s information • Information: raw material consumption, production rates, processing characteristics, equipment used, people involved, start and end time, etc.
create daily or shift production logs to track sugar processing status
record correctly and legibly the findings of quality testing in quality control documents
• record sampling process followed in production line • sampling record: includes sample sizes, sampling locations, sample collecting techniques, etc.
• maintain records of normal maintenance procedures • Procedures: repairs, calibrations, inspections, etc.
• ascertain all records are maintained per industry- specific regulations • Regulations: laws governing food safety, environment, product quality, etc.
• discuss documentation findings with appropriate parties to address concerns or issues • Parties: management, quality control teams, supervisors, etc.

modules.module_title: Carry out clarification of sugarcane juice

pcs.pc_description: pass the sugarcane juice to the vibrating screens/sieve baskets to remove solid particles, leaves and large debris
add prescribed amount of Sulphur dioxide or its derivates Sulphur metabisulphite to maintain the color and prolong the shelf life
heat the raw sugarcane juice at 70-75° C temperature in primary heaters to kill the bacteria (Leuconostoc)
transfer the raw juice to the lime station to add lime (calcium hydroxide) to the solution to aid precipitation and coagulation of particles, neutralize the pH level
pump the neutralized cane juice into continuous clarifier and add flocculants (to improve sedimentation or filterability of smaller particles
clear juice is skimmed or decanted from the top and the sludge/mud is disposed of for use as fertilizers
transfer the clear juice to vacuum evaporators for further processing
document the activities of the clarification process for quality audit and process improvement

modules.module_title: Carryout evaporation of sugarcane juice at the sugar mill

pcs.pc_description: • adjust various parameters of the evaporators to get the desired concentration of sugar cane juice • Parameters: temperature, pressure, flow rates
preheat the clarified sugarcane solution to improve the energy efficiency of the evaporation process

• add appropriate defoaming agents to prevent foam formation • defoaming agents’ type: silicone-based, polyglycol-based, mineral oil-based, fatty acid- based, non-ionic surfactants, food grade antifoam agents
transfer this solution to the series of multiple-effect evaporators in a controlled temperature
pass steam through the first evaporator which vaporizes the water in the sugarcane juice
vapour from the first evaporator moves to the second evaporator in the series and works as a heating medium
ensure the sugarcane juice flows through multiple effect evaporators to get a thicker syrup at each step
check the concentration level of the syrup at the end of the process, is as per the industry standards (from 10-15 Brix dissolved solids to 50-70 Brix thick syrup)
transfer the concentrated syrup to cooling chambers to reduce their temperature
• send sample to the appropriate department for quality check • quality check: sugar content, purity
store them in tanks or vessels until ready for the next process namely crystallization
document the activities of the evaporation process for quality audits and process improvement

modules.module_title: Carryout crystallization of concentrated sugar syrup at the sugar mill

pcs.pc_description: • adjust various parameters of the vacuum pan to get the desired sugar crystals • Parameters: temperature, pressure, vacuum levels
feed the sugar syrup into the vacuum pan crystallizers to begin the crystallization process
add small quantity of sugar crystals or seed crystals to initiate the crystallization process
monitor the seeding process for uniform crystal formation
check the seed crystals are distributed evenly using agitators/stirrers
• control supersaturation with these measures • Measures: seed crystals, agitator speed, antisolvents or crystal growth modifiers, pH control,
• monitor and test the progress of crystallization • Parameters: sugar content, crystal size, quality of the growing sugar crystals
control the cooling rate to promote uniform growth of sugar crystals
leave the mass of sugar crystals in the crystallizers after draining the syrup namely the molasses
transfer the sugar crystals to centrifuge separate sugar crystals from the remaining syrup (centrifuge rotates at 1000-2800 revolutions per minute)
use spring water to wash the crystals off the centrifuge
• send sample to the appropriate department for quality check • Quality check: flavor, color, purity, size
send the sugar crystals for drying station for drying process
